DECLARE @AVAILITY TABLE    (       MEMBERNUMBER VARCHAR(20),       ANSWER       DATE   )   INSERT INTO @AVAILITY (  MEMBERNUMBER, ANSWER ) SELECT DM.SUBSCRIBER_ID + '00' AS MEMBERNUMBER,         CONVERT(DATE, FMFC.ANSWER, 110) AS ANSWER FROM   [APP_CAEDM].[DW_DIM_FORM] DF  INNER JOIN [APP_CAEDM].[DW_DIM_FORM_CONCEPT_CONFIG] FCC ON DF.FORM_KEY = FCC.FORM_KEY  	AND DF.FORM_ID = 501009  INNER JOIN APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_CONCEPT C ON C.CONCEPT_KEY = FCC.CONCEPT_KEY  	AND C.CONCEPT_ID = 558898  INNER JOIN [APP_CAEDM].[DW_FACT_MEMBER_FORM_CONCEPT] FMFC ON FMFC.[FORM_CONCEPT_CONFIG_KEY] = FCC.FORM_CONCEPT_CONFIG_KEY  	AND ISDATE(FMFC.ANSWER) = 1  	AND LTRIM(RTRIM(LEN(FMFC.ANSWER))) < 4000  Logic added to address 4000 character length limitation of ISDATE function INNER JOIN [APP_CAEDM].[DW_FACT_MEMBER_FORM] FMM ON FMM.[MEMBER_FORM_KEY] = FMFC.MEMBER_FORM_KEY  INNER JOIN APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_MEMBER DM ON FMM.MEME_CK = DM.MEME_CK   SELECT MEMBERNUMBER,               ANSWER   FROM   @AVAILITY  WHERE  ANSWER >= CAST( GETDATE() + ? AS DATE)
